target_scope: predictor attention including dependency cross-attention; tokenizer frozen
loss: official head.compute_loss two-level next-token cross entropy, all shifted positions
epoch_definition: each asset-origin Jan1-25 stride120 window once, shuffled deterministically per epoch, no replacement
normalization: cast OHLCVA to float32 first, then mean/std of first256 only, eps1e-5, clip5; same numerical preprocessing as installed sktime KronosPredictor
ranking: competition rank <=2, retain ties and disclose set sizes
dynamic_baseline: std(ddof=0) of 255 log returns in 256 input closes times sqrt(30)
failure_policy: retain all scheduled windows, report failures/coverage; incomplete paired grid prevents acceptance
timing_policy: fresh smoke discarded, full reset; measured epoch1 is formal epoch1; no epoch repeats
selection_gate: small candidate MDD MAE strictly lower than original on complete300; any epoch major MDD MAE > original*1.2 stops before May
acceptance_gate: small candidate MDD MAE strictly lower than original and historical_30 on complete300
major_zero_reference: relative=null; candidate>0 stops; both zero does not stop
historical_30_baseline: MDD of last31 input closes (30 returns), scalar persistence
ranking_role: volatility Top2 and volatility MAE record only, never decision
publication_policy: no pitch or resume use without Yuki explicit personal confirmation
original_A_artifacts: read-only source code reuse; no old weights or February/March data
observation_policy: C records per-epoch April metrics; no added January observation inference
wall_time_policy: six-hour job safety cap; if insufficient room for complete May based on measured inference cost plus20min, interim without unseal; no automated restart
